text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen… Here, three friends, now hailed as the strongest in the racing world, will compete for glory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What will come out on top? Special Week's fighting spirit? Grass Wonder's intelligence? Or El Condor Pasa's aspirations?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a dream match to surpass the Mainichi Okan, and a takeoff point for El Condor Pasa's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This race will serve as an incredible test of her abilities and could become her path to the skies of the world.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've been running so much I've worn a path into the training track, El.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I might not be able to run with you for a while after this, but…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If I beat you and become the best in all of Japan, will you run against me again next year?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course! I can't take on the world if I'm only number two.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We'll settle things before I go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I don't know if I want to let you go or not.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I have one feeling that goes beyond my feelings for you as my friend…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: As a racer, I want to beat you. I want to best you with the skills I've quietly refined myself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't expect anything less, Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's what I love about you, and it's why you're my top rival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There are so many things we can't share as just friends, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Like, a ton! A whooole ton!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …That's true. I'm sorry. I know what I said isn't good for our friendship.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But let's make it happen, El. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's take everything we've learned in our days together and put it to use in this race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They all say everything they need to say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This battle royale is weaved from all three of their hopes. Only when it's finally over will the door to the rest of the world open.
